'''Saveel Yacommsa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. By [[3630 BBY]] he was wanted by the [[Eternal Empire]] for murder, treason, and espionage. He was last seen in the lower [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Zakuul]] and his wanted poster was displayed in the [[Overwatch]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Saveel Yacommsa appears during "Chapter 10: Anarchy in Paradise" of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' on a wanted holo-poster.
